note: San Juan NF (Columbine RD) campground ~6 mi west of Purgatory Ski Resort on Hermosa Park Rd (FR 578), ~9,000 ft: a small loop beside Sig Creek, ~200 m from the East Fork of Hermosa Creek. The FS says FR 578 to the campground is accessible by 2WD; the upper section over Bolam Pass is 4WD only. Hermosa Creek Trailhead is 2 mi past the campground. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov + catalog: confirmed $18, 9 sites, one vault toilet, potable water (main season). Booking changed reservable true -> false/FCFS always (recreation.gov: all sites Not Reservable, FCFS-only rate seasons; FS page still claims summer reservations, flagged). Cleared the note-derived max_rig_ft 35 (no agency length). Added season note, fees checked 2026. Note rewritten: field facts and unsourced road commentary dropped, creek distance corrected.
flags: Booking conflict: the FS page says 'Campground is available for reservations from late May through mid-August at Recreation.gov. Outside the peak season, sites are first come, first served.' But recreation.gov's catalog marks all 9 sites 'Not Reservable' (Scan & Pay) and its only rate seasons for 2025-2028 are 'First-come, First-served Season' (2026: May 22 - Sept 6). Recorded first-come per recreation.gov; a human may want to confirm with Columbine RD.

Length: no agency figure. The stored 'listed max RV 35 ft' came from note prose; the FS page states no maximum and the recreation.gov catalog has no Max Vehicle Length on any site. Cleared max_rig_ft. Neither page singles the campground out for small rigs; FS: 'It is accessible by 2WD vehicles.'

Phone missing: Columbine Ranger District (970) 884-2512 (FS page office contact, Bayfield). recreation.gov gives the concessionaire's line: 'For facility specific information, please call (661) 702-1420' (goexplorus.com email).
Operator: concessionaire (Explorus, per recreation.gov contact email) on San Juan NF land; ownership left federal.

Road/flood: FR 578 Hermosa Park, Columbine RD road status as of October 26, 2026: 'Hermosa Park: Mile 0.4 - 8.7 | 578 | 5/1 | 9/8-10/13, 11/14 | Temporary closure dates: Sept. 8 - Oct. 13, 2026; closed just beyond the intersection of Hermosa Park Road and Hermosa Creek Trailhead.' (that closure point is 2 mi past the campground). FR 578 is NOT among the flood-damaged roads in the October 22-25, 2026 table (Fossett Gulch 613, Spring Creek 537 and Lower Piedra are); the forest-wide alert of October 23 still warns 'Many roads are closed' and 'All roadways are expected to be saturated'. No campground closure: FS says open to November 15, 2026 with limited services.

Pin 37.63208,-107.88430 sits south of Hermosa Park Rd at a junction/parking clearing; the FS point 37.6335,-107.8838 is on the campground's small loop north of the road (labelled 'Sig Crk CG Rd' on Esri topo), ~165 m away. Within the ~500 m tolerance but the FS point is the better pin. recreation.gov has no facility or site coordinates.

Waterfront (stored not waterfront, kept): the East Fork of Hermosa Creek runs through the meadow south of the road, ~200 m from the loop (the old note's '~1/4 mi' overstated it). Sig Creek, a small side stream, runs ~20-40 m west of the loop per Esri topo but is under continuous canopy on imagery, so creekside cannot be confirmed. The FS page's 'spacious sites nestled close to the creek' is review-summary prose, not a basis.
